 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bayer Leverkusen return to Bundesliga action on Saturday looking to build momentum after their derby victory over Cologne. However, SC Paderborn have proven difficult to beat in recent weeks, with Ralf Kettemann's side hoping to frustrate the hosts and take something away from their trip to the BayArena.
 Here is our full preview for this exciting Bundesliga match:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bayer Leverkusen
 Carles Martinez's Bayer Leverkusen head into the tenth matchday sitting fifth in the Bundesliga table with 16 points, having made a positive start to the campaign despite some defensive inconsistencies.
 Leverkusen secured an important derby victory over Cologne before the international break, scoring twice to claim all three points. However, Martinez will still have concerns about his side's defensive performances, with Die Werkself conceding at least once in each of their last five matches in all competitions.
 The hosts will nevertheless be confident of extending their unbeaten record against Paderborn in competitive fixtures. Their most recent meeting in the DFB-Pokal, however, proved far from straightforward, with Leverkusen requiring extra time to overcome their opponents.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Another victory on Saturday would provide an opportunity to strengthen their position in the European qualification places, although Paderborn's compact defensive approach could make life difficult for the hosts.
 Team News 
 Leverkusen have received a welcome boost ahead of Saturday's fixture, with their injury situation beginning to improve after a difficult spell.
 Ibrahim Maza is expected to be available despite returning early from international duty with Algeria due to an ankle problem. Martinez confirmed that the midfielder could be included in the squad, although his fitness will need to be assessed.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nathan Tella and Moussa Diaby are also available, while Christian Kofane, Kennet Eichhorn and Guela Doué could return to the squad after spells on the sidelines.
 Martin Terrier remains the only confirmed absentee with a long-term injury.
 SC Paderborn
 Ralf Kettemann's SC Paderborn travel to Leverkusen sitting 13th in the Bundesliga table with ten points from their opening nine matches.
 The newly promoted side have experienced a mixed start to life in the top flight, but their recent performances suggest they could prove awkward opponents for the hosts.
 Paderborn have drawn three of their last five matches, demonstrating an ability to remain competitive against established Bundesliga sides through their compact defensive organisation. Their goalless draw against Borussia Mönchengladbach was another example of their resilience at the back.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Team News 
 Paderborn are hoping to have centre-back Tjark Scheller available for the trip to Leverkusen, with the defender facing a late fitness test. Should he fail to recover in time, Felix Götze is expected to be an alternative.
 Tom Baack is also carrying a knock, meaning Laurin Ulrich could come into contention for a starting position in midfield.
